ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels dominate approximately 90% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to approximately 10% concentrated at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white patches are localized at the lateral tips. The left tip shows fragmented white mottling within a dark border. The right tip shows a denser white patch with internal low-intensity spotting. The central area from peduncle to notch is solid low-intensity pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch with an approximate pixel angle of 135 degrees and a moderate depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the majority of the trailing edge. Distinct irregular peaks and jagged valleys are most pronounced on the outer margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Anterior edges show a convex sweep upward and outward. The trailing edge follows a complex path with a general concave trajectory as it approaches the median notch from the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible as dark, roughly circular pixel clusters embedded within the high-intensity white patches at both the left and right distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent white scarring and irregular tissue erosion at the tips of both fluke lobes, consistent with localized physical trauma or parasitic attachment sites.
